title: Multiplier Lock
prompt: Crack the gate code! What multiplier (r) powers each stone to the next?
hint: Divide any stone by the stone right before it (6 ÷ 3 or 12 ÷ 6).
explanation: Every step doubles the stone before it (3 × 2 = 6, 6 × 2 = 12) — multiplier r = 2!

title: Rune Doubling Gate
prompt: The ancient stone power doubles with every platform. If the first stone has power 7, what is the power of the 3rd stone?

title: Missing Power Stone
prompt: Power up the next platform! Which number belongs on the [ ? ] stone?
hint: Each stone triples (× 3). Multiply 135 by 3 to power the next stone!
explanation: The pattern triples every step (r = 3), so 135 × 3 = 405 unlocks the gate!

title: Quad Rune Pulse
prompt: Each platform multiplies energy by 4. Find the missing number in the sequence!

title: Shrinking Spell
prompt: Each stone halves in power! What value unlocks the 6th stone [ ? ]?
hint: Every jump divides by 2 (× ½). Cut 10 in half one more time!
explanation: Halving at each step gives 20 → 10 on the 5th stone, and 10 ÷ 2 = 5 on the 6th!

title: Thirds Chamber
prompt: Energy is dividing by 3 at each chamber. What is the value of the next stone?

title: Master Rune Formula
prompt: Forge the nth-stone spell (aₙ) when the 1st stone is a₁ = 4 and multiplier is r = 3:
hint: Use the geometric rune rule: aₙ = (first stone a₁) · r^(n - 1).
explanation: Starting at a₁ = 4 and multiplying by r = 3 each step gives aₙ = 4 · 3^(n - 1)!

title: Fifth Term Arcana
prompt: For a sequence where the first stone a₁ = 2 and multiplier r = 5, what is the 4th stone (a₄)?

title: Flip-Sign Boss Gate
prompt: Watch the signs flip! What number lands on the 5th stone [ ? ]?
hint: Multiply by -3 each time! Remember: a negative times a negative turns positive.
explanation: The multiplier is r = -3, so (-54) × (-3) = +162 smashes the final gate!

title: Summit Sign Inversion
prompt: The Summit Gate flips signs with each jump: 5, -10, 20, -40... What is the next term?
hint: Multiply -40 by -2. A negative times a negative gives a positive!
